title: Princess Leia
description: Princess Leia Organa was raised by Queen Breha Organa of Alderaan and her husband, Senator Bail Organa. Bail had conspired with Obi-Wan Kenobi and Yoda to hide Anakin Skywalker's children, so he and Breha took in Leia. To draw Kenobi out of hiding, the Third Sister arranged Leia's kidnapping. Kenobi rescued her and bonded with the headstrong young royal.
